Category previews use the same renderers as placed widgets. Dotted clocks and styled analog/world previews are bitmaps refreshed about once a minute when optional Alarms & reminders access is on; otherwise the live platform clock is shown. Battery readouts come from the system battery level. The Mini preset has no text layer, so Dotwel adds the real level in its own dot glyphs; no charge state is invented. Battery2 shows only a real charging-time estimate from the system while charging; it never invents discharge hours or minutes and says the estimate is unavailable when Android has no value.

Weather is optional and off by default. Before you consent, no location is stored and no request is made. The city is chosen manually; there is no GPS, device-location or background-location access and no telemetry.

When you search, MET Norway receives the city text you typed. When you choose a result and refresh, it receives that city's coordinates plus your network IP address. A refresh requests the forecast and current conditions. This app does not request air-quality data, so no AQI is shown. After you enable weather and select a city, opening or resuming the app may refresh a stale cached forecast at most once an hour. There is no background network polling. This app uses MET Norway as a personal, noncommercial service and shows attribution. Forecasts are cached privately and are not uploaded.
